summary: Iteration 5 tested the new reset modes (search / industry / life). Backend: 4/4 pytest passed. PUT /api/profile keeps reset_mode and the life-mode answers. GET /api/recommendations returns mode=life/industry, and mode=search when an old profile has no reset_mode. Frontend at 375x667, all flows passed. Step 1 'Jaki reset Cię interesuje?' shows 3 cards and Dalej is disabled (aria-disabled) until one is picked. The counter is 10 for search, 11 for industry and 13 for life. Switching mode on step 1 removes the extra steps (11->10, 13->10). Life steps 3-5 enforce the required fields (has_idea, new_directions). The full life quiz (current_job: księgowa) leads to the matches screen with caption 'WIELKI RESET · NOWE ŻYCIE'. All 10 careers are outside finance (pet sitter, barista, groomer, technik weterynarii, own café, agroturystyka). Editing the quiz from the profile prefills reset_mode and the life answers (life card selected, 'Pytanie 1 z 13', idea text kept). The legacy user ania_t1 sees 'TWOJE DOPASOWANIA', and in edit mode Dalej is disabled until a mode is picked. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the reviewed files.

minor.issue: For a księgowa targeting IT and Logistyka, the careers are in the new industries but some are still finance work: 'Analityk biznesowy / finansowy w IT', 'Specjalista ds. kontrolingu logistycznego', 'Product Owner w fintechu'. This fits 'reuse my skills', but the prompt could tell the model to avoid finance-type duties more firmly.

integration_issues.flow: Switching mode after filling mode-specific steps
integration_issues.issue: QUIZ_STEPS showIf only hides steps. Answers given in another mode (has_idea, idea, new_directions, loves, life_values, target_industries, leave_reason) stay in the answers state and are sent with PUT /profile. Example: a user fills life steps, goes back and picks 'search' or 'industry'. The LLM prompt still contains the 'idea'/'new_directions' data (profile_text dumps all answers), which can skew search/industry results. Reference: /app/frontend/app/quiz.tsx:52-60

issues: Before a mode is picked the counter reads 'Pytanie 1 z 10' and then jumps to 11 or 13 after selection. Minor UX; consider hiding the total until a mode is picked.
The third card 'Wielki Reset' is partly hidden behind the sticky Dalej bar at 375x667. The user has to scroll to read its description. Acceptable.

action_items: Before PUT /profile in quiz.tsx, drop answers for steps whose showIf is false, so mode-specific keys from a mode the user left are not sent.
(Optional) Make MODE_RULES['industry'] avoid roles with the same core duties (finance/controlling for an accountant) unless the user selected that industry.
critical_code_review_comments: quiz.tsx: answers keep keys from hidden steps (see integration_issues).

quiz-steps.ts: 'industry' mode lists 'Finanse i księgowość' in target_industries. If it is the user's current industry, this conflicts with MODE_RULES 'NIE proponuj stanowisk w obecnej branży'. Edge case.
server.py: mode is saved only when generation succeeds (status ready). Good. It falls back to 'search' for old profiles.
